thread:
jordan (support): FYI incoming from ACME — they reported repeated 503/504s during a billing window and say their audit logs are missing entries for ~2h. They pasted a pen-test finding that also noted a log-retention gap. Escalating.

erin (secops): thanks. do we have correlation between the reported client timestamps and our ingestion pipeline?

jordan (support): they gave a customer-side trace id: trace-ACME-2026-03-01-18:12:43. also attached a screenshot of their billing spike. short: errors + unexpected usage billing.

maria (security-eng): the pen-test doc attached to the ticket mentions an S3 lifecycle misconfig that could have pruned audit buckets earlier than policy. filing that with infra now.

sam (infra): looking at S3 lifecycle logs now. can someone paste the exact customer timestamps? need to map to our object delete events.

jordan (support): customer claims missing logs between 2026-03-01T16:00:00Z and 2026-03-01T18:00:00Z. trace id above occurs at 18:12:43Z.

erin (secops): @sam please check vault rotation and KMS usage for that window — pen testers flagged a possible KMS alias enumeration during the same timeframe.

sam (infra): quick grep on CloudTrail for ACME trace id: ran: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventId,AttributeValue=trace-ACME-2026-03-01-18:12:43` — nothing returned. running broader query for PutObject/DeleteObject in audit buckets.

maria (security-eng): to be explicit: the pen-test finding severity is disputed by the redteam (they rate as medium) and customer wants GRC-level severity (high) because of regulated logs. we need a reproducible repro and evidence chain.

tasha (customer-success): customer extremely nervous. they want confirmation that retention policy changes weren't applied retroactively to their data. also asking for a one-page summary for legal.

sam (infra): found multiple DeleteObjects for `redwood-audit-archive/2026/03/01/` with timestamps around 2026-03-01T17:05:xxZ to 17:07:xxZ. looks like a lifecycle job kicked. putting raw events below: 
```
2026-03-01T17:05:10Z DeleteObjects BatchId=lkj23-... Target=redwood-audit-archive Prefix=2026/03/01/
2026-03-01T17:05:11Z DeleteObjects BatchId=lkj23-... Objects=1000
```

auditsvc-bot: Archive lifecycle job `lifecycle-pruner-2026-02` executed on 2026-03-01T17:05:09Z with rule `retain-90-days` (applied to bucket redwood-audit-archive).

maria (security-eng): can we confirm whether that lifecycle rule was changed recently? It should be 365 days for prod audits. If it was incorrectly set to 90, that's an error.

sam (infra): config history shows rule created 2026-02-28 by `deploy-bot` as part of maintenance. diff below: 
```
- retention: 365
+ retention: 90
```

deploy-bot: Change set applied by pipeline `infra-maint-2026-02` — modification to S3 lifecycle for `redwood-audit-archive`. CI run: https://ci.internal/runs/4829 (owner: infra-ops).

erin (secops): ok that explains gap. we need an immediate remediation plan: 1) stop further deletions, 2) attempt object-level recovery from versioned backups or Glacier if available, 3) produce customer-facing timeline, 4) coordinate with compliance/legal.

jordan (support): customer asked if the missing window includes KMS-wrapped keys or HSM exports. pen-test notes an alias enumeration vector but didn't show key material exfil. need to confirm.

maria (security-eng): KMS audit: no ExportKeyMaterial events. there were DescribeKey/DescribeKeyAliases calls from internal service account `infra-batch` around 2026-03-01T16:50Z. pulling full logs.

sam (infra): short term stop: applied an S3 BlockPublicAcls + disabled lifecycle runner for `redwood-audit-archive` at 2026-03-01T18:30:00Z.

auditsvc-bot: Lifecycle job `lifecycle-pruner-2026-02` paused by user `sam` at 2026-03-01T18:30:21Z.

tasha (customer-success): CC @ACME — telling them we paused the job. they replied: ":eyes: please confirm retrieval plan and cost impact".

erin (secops): evidence collation steps: 1) record S3 DeleteObjects events, 2) record pipeline change sets, 3) export CloudTrail events for DescribeKey/DescribeAliases, 4) export KMS usage metrics for the period, 5) check for Glacier Deep Archive retrieval possibility.

jordan (support): customer also reported spurious 5xxs and a billing spike — are these related? maybe the retention job coincided with an autoscaling misconfig that caused replayed events/billing replays.

sam (infra): investigating API error spike: checked autoscaler logs around 16:00-18:30Z. saw elevated queue latencies and ~15% request retries due to worker OOMs. suspects a deploy earlier same day. pulling deploy timeline.

deploy-bot: Deploy `svc-runtime@2026.03.01-159` executed at 2026-03-01T15:58:12Z. Rollback not triggered.

maria (security-eng): link the two: if the deploy increased request retries, that could have generated more logs which bumped storage usage and hit a lifecycle prune rule if it was incorrectly short. it's messy but plausible. we must present a coherent timeline.

erin (secops): severity assessment: for GRC, this is high because regulated audit logs were deleted earlier than policy. redteam medium rating stands for exploitation risk; customer impact raises severity. propose: mark incident severity=high, start remediation timeline and commit to external notification.

jordan (support): customer asked for repro steps and evidence. here's a suggested repro kit to share with internal reviewers (remove sensitive tokens): 
```
1) Query cloudtrail for DeleteObjects events: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2026-03-01T17:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-01T17:10:00Z --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=DeleteObjects`
2) Fetch lifecycle change set: `aws s3api get-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket redwood-audit-archive`
3) Export pipeline diff: `cictl changeset infra-maint-2026-02 --output unified`
```

tasha (customer-success): customer asked if we'll do a payback for storage/billing spike. legal wants options. Jordan please coordinate.

erin (secops): next actions: 
- [ ] produce internal postmortem draft (security-owned) 
- [ ] attempt recovery via versioned objects or Glacier restore (infra) 
- [ ] notify customer with timeline and remediation steps (cs + legal) 
- [ ] escalate to execs if recovery fails

sam (infra): starting recovery attempt now — listing versions for prefix: `aws s3api list-object-versions --bucket redwood-audit-archive --prefix 2026/03/01/`

maria (security-eng): also we should run the pen-test repro steps in a sandbox to confirm alias enumeration vector and close the loop on whether it enabled anything. will coordinate with red team.

jordan (support): I'll draft the customer note: pause lifecycle job, retrievability attempts, initial severity assessment high, ETA for next update 4h.

erin (secops): all good. capture this conversation as evidence in the incident tracker (INC-2026-0432). I'll attach CloudTrail exports and the pipeline diff.

maria (security-eng): final note: for the severity dispute — document both the redteam's technical rating and customer-impact-driven classification so auditors see rationale.

jordan (support): thanks everyone. I'll update ticket and ping legal. keep this thread for rapid comms. :white_check_mark:
